title: Louis D. Brandeis Professor of Law
bio: Nikolas Bowie is the Louis D. Brandeis Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. He is a historian who teaches courses in federal constitutional law, state constitutional law, and local government law. His research focuses on critical legal histories of democracy in the United States. With Daphna Renan, he is the author of the forthcoming book, Supremacy: […]
